policy: Gate-protected, complementary-pair, multi-die, integrated-network, depletion/JFET, and other unsupported topologies receive zero model calls and remain in the denominator.
method: Every canonical PDF was inspected before semantic extraction using layout-preserving text. Page 1 was rendered and visually checked for all PDFs with missing/garbled text and every candidate whose wording or schematic indicated protection, multiple devices, a junction FET, or package-layout ambiguity.
